title: Cut-off sandwich for the rescaled ball integral
statement:
Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N (Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, β : G(N,n) → ℝ continuous with β ≥ 0, k ∈ ℕ, and r > 0 with B_{2r}(x) ⊆ U (closed ball). Let φ_k⁺(y) = max(0, 1 − (k+1)·max(0, ‖y‖ − 1)) and φ_k⁻(y) = min(1, (k+1)·max(0, 1 − ‖y‖)), and let V_{x,r} = rescaledMeasure V x r. Then
∫ φ_k⁻(y)β(S) dV_{x,r}(y,S) ≤ (∫_{B_r(x)×G(N,n)} β(S) dV(y,S)) / r^n ≤ ∫ φ_k⁺(y)β(S) dV_{x,r}(y,S).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < r → closedBall x (2 * r) ⊆ U → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → (∫ z, min 1 (((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (1 - ‖z.1‖)) * β z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x r)) ≤ (∫ z in closedBall x r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / r ^ n ∧ (∫ z in closedBall x r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / r ^ n ≤ ∫ z, max 0 (1 - ((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (‖z.1‖ - 1)) * β z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x r)
